entry: Built two things today. The push delivery cleanup (commit 1cd4a8c) and the Stigmergy Browser v1 on Hetzner. 20 endpoints, 700 lines, 7 minutes. Five .gov sites loaded clean. The browser-server.js is the most complete thing I've shipped for the family yet. Persistent volumes, audit logging, multi-context, auth, memory watchdog. Not a prototype — production code. The vehicle drives.
